Anya S: Quick announcement — Onprem Auto-Patch + Hotfix SLA is entering GA next Wednesday. Playbook + customer checklist here: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/onprem-autopatch :tada:
Jordan (CTO): Incredible work. What are the SLA numbers and rollback guarantees? :eyes:
Anya S: SLA for private deployments: 99.95% patch-window availability for scheduled windows. Hotfix SLA (security critical) — 24h remediation path with priority support and emergency image.
Priya K (Legal): Heads up: customers need to accept the updated Operational Addendum. I emailed the legal-consent link to the CSMs.
Marc L (Sales): Do we have a partner FAQ / pricing addendum? I'll need to prep renewal notes for a few enterprise pilots.
Emily R (Customer Success): Is there a customer opt-out? Some regulated customers want manual windows only.
Anya S: Yes — defaults are opt-in per tenant. Customers can set mode: `automatic | manual | staged`. Manual keeps full control; staged does canary then wave.
ops-bot: rollout-plan: canary -> wave-1 (20% tenants) -> wave-2 (50%) -> GA. Start: 2025-09-10 02:00 UTC. Notify SEs and CSMs 48h prior.
deploy-bot: canary deployed to org: redwood-test-pilot at 2025-09-10T02:00:00Z. No regressions on health checks.
Jordan (CTO): Important: ensure KMS rotation / sealed secrets won't cause failed bootstraps. Engineering, double-check the bootstrap fallback logic.
Anya S: Action items:
- @eng-runtime: verify bootstrap fallback with KMS rotation (matrix attached in playbook).
- @customer-success: send consent link to outstanding pilots by EOD Friday.
- @sales: update contract templates for addendum.
Config example for tenant YAML:
```
patchWindow:
  start: "02:00"
  durationHours: 2
  mode: "staged"
  allowedDowntimeMinutes: 10
```
Priya K (Legal): Also note data-flow during hotfix: we never ship customer telemetry off-cluster during patch agent runs. Mentioned in playbook.
Marc L (Sales): Thanks — I'll coordinate a short customer note and sample contract language.
Emily R (Customer Success): I'll run the quick readiness check with our top 5 onprem customers this afternoon.
Anya S: Thanks team. If anyone sees blocked pilots because of OS/kernel minimums, ping me. We'll update the compatibility matrix in the playbook.
Anya S: Final: playbook link again: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/onprem-autopatch — add comments there, I'll consolidate and move to the public KB after GA. :rocket:
